purpose: Real train-only end-to-end finite execution and throughput; not learning/quality evidence; weights excluded from formal initialization
dev_access: none: inherit expected digest from frozen source manifest without opening dev file

generation.allowed_input: terminal plus own random noise or autoregressive prefix

losses.common_K: sum sampled(logq-logp)/(B*48); beta=1; preserve negative MC estimate
losses.scalar: legacy target-index MSE and legacy KL; whole-pipeline comparator, not single-component causal control

AR.classification: paper-informed canonical adaptation; not faithful official reproduction
AR.support: capped48, shifted BOS inputs; first EOS supervision only for length<48

endpoint: fixed updates if completed within cap; final checkpoint; no model selection
failure: nonfinite/data identity/budget/generation error: retain failed stage and all request slots; no retry; formal only after engineering diagnosis and separately frozen correction if necessary
data_evaluation: no development losses, distribution metrics or biological claims; throughput, finite outputs, condition interface and hashes only
formal_budget_rule: Use measured seconds/update and fixed historical 1000/1000 anchor; choose one common end-to-end training ceiling and fixed VAE/DDPM update counts before formal outcomes. AR gets comparable ceiling with throughput-derived steps. Record actual costs; never claim exact equal compute when unequal. No architecture/loss/seed selection using smoke quality.

descriptor_train.verification: row-wise sequence and terminal match with frozen cohort train; descriptor source unchanged; train-only population scaler

optimizer_contract.ddpm_noise: linear beta 1e-4..0.02,999 steps; train and reverse timesteps1..998
optimizer_contract.phase_budget: VAE90s+DDPM90s; shared total180s, checked before update, encode batch; in-flight atomic operation may finish
